_comment: Story mode content. Every line here is final copy, recorded verbatim by the voice actors. Lines are short by design: 1-2 sentences, spoken in under 6 seconds, because a 3-year-old will not sit through more. Each chapter gates 3 activities and awards one colored light.

hero.designNotes: Small red panda, warm rust fur, cream face markings, carries a paper lantern on a short stick. Rounded silhouette, no sharp angles. Expressive eyes, always kind. Never frightened, never scolds. Yun is the child's peer, not a teacher.

premise.en: The big lantern at the top of the hill has gone dark. Yun sets out to find eight little lights to bring it back.
premise.zh: 山顶上的大灯笼灭了。小云出发去找八个小灯光，把它重新点亮。

open.en: Yun's lantern went out. Look — a tiny red light, way up in the apple tree!
open.zh: 小云的灯笼灭了。快看——苹果树上有一点红色的光！

beat.en: The apples are too high. If we help Bear fill his basket, maybe he will lift us up.
beat.zh: 苹果太高了。我们帮熊装满篮子，他也许会把我们举高。

close.en: You did it! One red light. Seven more to find.
close.zh: 你做到了！一个红色的光。还要找七个。

open.en: In Shape Village every house is a different shape. The wind blew the roofs away!
open.zh: 形状村里，每座房子都是不一样的形状。大风把屋顶吹跑了！

beat.en: A round roof for a round house. Can you help each one find its own?
beat.zh: 圆的屋顶配圆的房子。你能帮它们找到自己的吗？

close.en: Every house has its roof back. Here is your orange light!
close.zh: 每座房子都有屋顶了。这是你的橙色灯光！

chapters.skill: sorting and classification by color and category

open.en: The river washed everything into one big pile. Duck cannot find anything!
open.zh: 河水把所有东西冲成了一大堆。鸭子什么都找不到了！

beat.en: Let's put the things that go together, together.
beat.zh: 我们把一样的东西放在一起吧。

close.en: All tidy. Duck says thank you — and gives you a yellow light.
close.zh: 都整理好了。鸭子谢谢你——送你一个黄色的灯光。

chapters.skill: size, length, and height comparison and ordering

open.en: The mountain is very tall. Yun is very small. We will need a ladder.
open.zh: 山很高。小云很小。我们需要一个梯子。

beat.en: Short step, then taller, then tallest. That is how a ladder is built.
beat.zh: 先矮的，再高一点，最后最高的。梯子就是这样搭的。

close.en: Up we go! At the top, a green light was waiting.
close.zh: 我们爬上去啦！山顶上有一个绿色的灯光在等你。

chapters.skill: spatial position: up, down, inside, outside, in front, behind

open.en: The fog is thick here. Yun can hear friends, but cannot see them.
open.zh: 这里的雾很浓。小云能听见朋友，可是看不见他们。

beat.en: Owl says: I am up. Frog says: I am down. Can you find them?
beat.zh: 猫头鹰说：我在上面。青蛙说：我在下面。你能找到他们吗？

close.en: Everyone found. The fog lifts, and a blue light shines through.
close.zh: 大家都找到了。雾散开了，一个蓝色的灯光照进来。

chapters.skill: AB, ABB, ABC patterns and pattern extension

open.en: At night the flowers here light up in a pattern. But some have gone dark.
open.zh: 晚上，这里的花会按规律亮起来。可是有几朵灭了。

beat.en: Red, blue, red, blue... what comes next?
beat.zh: 红色、蓝色、红色、蓝色……接下来是什么？

close.en: The whole meadow is glowing again. A purple light floats up to you.
close.zh: 整片草原又亮起来了。一个紫色的灯光飘到你面前。

open.en: The lake shows everything twice. One on top, one underneath.
open.zh: 湖面把每样东西都照出两个。上面一个，下面一个。

beat.en: Butterfly lost one wing in the water. Can you make both sides match?
beat.zh: 蝴蝶的一只翅膀掉进水里了。你能让两边一模一样吗？

close.en: Butterfly can fly again. She leaves you a pink light.
close.zh: 蝴蝶又能飞了。她留给你一个粉色的灯光。

chapters.skill: mixed review of all prior skills

open.en: Seven lights. One to go. The big lantern is just up this path.
open.zh: 七个灯光了。还差一个。大灯笼就在这条路的尽头。

beat.en: The last light is inside the lantern itself. It only needs a little help waking up.
beat.zh: 最后一个灯光就在大灯笼里面。它只是需要一点帮助醒过来。

close.en: Look at that! The whole hill is bright. You brought the light back, and Yun will never forget it.
close.zh: 快看！整座山都亮了。是你把光带回来的，小云永远不会忘记。
